name: director-dashboard-gap-workflow
title: Director Swarm Dashboard Gap Workflow
description: Wire the Director Swarm to use command-center as a complementary outcome/health signal (alongside swarm-manager's work-level detail) and to monitor /api/v1/gaps for missing metrics. Swarm Manager tells the director what work is happening; command-center tells the director whether that work is producing results. Dashboard gaps become automatic signals for capability development: Director spots gap → proposes backlog → human approves → Feature team builds pipeline → gap flips to live → cycle repeats.
